Product.title: Product
Product.description: A product available in the shop.

description.description: A detailed description of the product.

category.description: The category of the product (Desechables, CARTS NACIONALES, CARTS IMPORTADOS, BATERIAS, COMBOS).

flavor.description: The flavor profile of the product.

stock.description: The current quantity available in inventory.

images.description: List of URLs to the product images.

cbdContent.description: The product quality or tier (e.g., Premium, Elite).

userId.description: The ID of the user who made the purchase.

discountAmount.description: The amount discounted from the total.

promoCode.description: The promo code used for this order.

discountValue.description: The value of the discount (e.g., 20 for 20% or $20).

isActive.description: Whether the code is currently active.

usageCount.description: How many times this code has been used.

/products/{productId}.description: Collection of products available for sale.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Collection of orders placed by users.
